The Moment of Discovery

She'd walked past that corner of the garden for six years without really seeing it.

Then she looked again — and found exactly where the therapy practice she'd been putting off could quietly begin.

The Transformation

Her mother has her own corner of it now — close enough to hear the kids, far enough to still finish a chapter of her book.

Same site. Same garden they'd shared for thirty years. A home that finally fit the family living in it.

Nothing about your home has to change today for this to already be true.

Every plot is a piece of land. This is where its next chapter starts.
